Country	Country
State	State
Bioregion	IBRA7 region name
Dataset	Dataset (either AusPlotsForest, CSIRO, Injune or Supersite)
Site.Name	Site name
Unit.Code	Unit code (incl. site name and subplot code)
Year	Year of survey
Unit.Dimensions_m	Unit dimensions (in m)
Unit.Area_ha	Unit area (in ha)
Xutm_m	Easting of the unit center (in m)
Yutm_m	Northing of the unit center (in m)
UTM.Zone	UTM zone (Southern hemisphere)
paulAGB.Mean_mg/ha	Mean estimated aboveground biomass per unit using Paul et al. 2016 allometry (in Mg/ha)
chaveAGB.Mean_mg/ha	Mean estimated aboveground biomass per unit using Chave et al. 2014 allometry (in Mg/ha)
chaveAGB.Cred2.5_mg/ha	Lower bound of 95% credibility interval for AGB computed using Chave et al. 2014 allometry (in Mg/ha)
chaveAGB.Cred97.5_mg/ha	Upper bound of 95% credibility interval for AGB computed using Chave et al. 2014 allometry (in Mg/ha)
TCH_m	Mean top-of-canopy height over unit area (in m)
